meta.title: Order Activity records a surrogate bid added
gaps: Verify the activity entry contains the exact buyer identity and date/time.
Verify no earlier activity is missing and that all activity entries are in chronological order.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the activity entry contains the exact buyer identity and date/time.; Verify no earlier activity is missing and that all activity entries are in chronological order.

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage can be published and used for surrogate bidding.
Every create flow requires a title before publishing.
Use an RFQ stage, which supports the required surrogate bid flow.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Provide one product for the surrogate bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before scheduling and publishing.
Invite one QA test vendor so an Add Bid control is available.
Publish the event so the buyer can place a surrogate bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the published RFQ Participants list where surrogate bidding is initiated.
Place the required buyer-side bid on behalf of the invited vendor.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted and submitted.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and select Order Activity.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer or activity section is displayed.
Check that the activity history contains an entry identifying the surrogate bid.
